baseline_models.mechanism: The imperative opens deliberate audition; the doubled call construction supplies a raised voice, and the place-plus-near phrase gives that voice a locally reachable source.

activation_trace.role: Auditory perception supplies the literal act demanded by the imperative.
Raised voice and calling supply the audible event and its caller.
Place as a locus of being localizes the sound source.
Nearness against distance makes the localized source immediately audible.

changed_reading.after: Keep an intentional acoustic watch for a raised call whose source is locally near.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The intentional form ٱسْتَمِعْ is directed toward a call rather than an accidental sound.
baseline_models.mechanism: The hearing branch joins understanding to acceptance and compliance, so the command requests an answerable posture rather than bare sensory registration; proximity makes the summons encounterable now, not abstractly remote.

activation_trace.role: Understanding, acceptance, and compliance turn listening into responsive reception.
The raised call supplies an addressed summons to which hearing can respond.
Approach and contact make the summons an impending encounter rather than distant information.

changed_reading.before: Listening is passive reception of sound.
changed_reading.after: Listening means understanding and yielding oneself to an immediately encounterable summons.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يُنَادِ ٱلْمُنَادِ links a caller and act of calling to a specified nearby place.
baseline_models.mechanism: The N-D-W/N-D-Y gathering branches let the call function as convocation: a voice does not merely report an event but assembles participants at an eventful locus.

activation_trace.role: The council and gathering image supplies the social body summoned by the caller.
A meeting place and assembled company turn the named place into a convocation locus.
The severe event-day gives the assembly a decisive occasion.
Spatial nearness makes the convocation locus convergent and immediate.

changed_reading.before: One hearer is told to notice one caller.
changed_reading.after: A caller issues a muster signal for assembly at a decisive nearby locus.

context_deltas.mechanism: At 50:16 hidden self-speech is accessible and nearness is measured against an internal bodily cord. Carried into مَّكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ, proximity can denote intimate access to the listener, not only a short external radius.

activation_trace.role: The focus adjective anchors the revised geometry in explicit nearness.
A hidden sound supplies the quietest acoustic scale and makes access inwardly intimate.
Comparative nearness reuses the focus root and locates proximity at the person.
Bodily vessels and connections furnish an interior measure for that nearness.

structural_cues: 50:16 couples hidden speech with bodily comparative nearness; 50:41 later localizes a call by the same nearness root.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden sound, comparative nearness, and an internal cord; I transfer that relational geometry to the later nearby place. A live alternative is that 50:16's nearness and 50:41's caller-location remain unrelated.

changed_reading.before: The caller occupies a nearby external coordinate.
changed_reading.after: The call arrives from a proximity so intimate that external distance no longer protects an inner self from being reached.

context_deltas.mechanism: 50:37 pairs a heart with casting one's hearing while present as witness. The focus imperative therefore asks for deliberate self-placement in receptive presence, strengthening the compliance model beyond ordinary audibility.

activation_trace.role: Understanding and compliance anchor the focus command as receptive action.
The heart supplies the inward cognitive counterpart to attentive hearing.
Casting or placing something down makes hearing an intentionally offered faculty.
The repeated hearing root explicitly couples reception with understanding and acceptance.
Presence with witnessing gives listening an evidentiary posture.

structural_cues: 50:37's أَلْقَى ٱلسَّمْعَ precedes 50:41's imperative ٱسْتَمِعْ by four ayat and explicitly adds heart and witness-presence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a deliberate casting of hearing beside heart and witness; I treat 50:41 as the later enactment of that posture. Alternatively, 50:37 may characterize a general recipient while 50:41 addresses a distinct listener-role.

changed_reading.before: Attend so that the call is heard.
changed_reading.after: Offer the whole faculty of hearing, understand, and stand present as a witness when the call comes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate continuation names the heard cry as the day of exit; the cry inventory includes a sounding fissure, and 50:44 then opens the earth. This supports a material model in which the call is an operative acoustic breach that releases what was enclosed.

activation_trace.role: The raised call supplies the initiating sound anchored in the focus.
Actual auditory perception confirms that the focus command reaches a heard event.
A sounding fissure fuses cry with rupture and supplies the breach image.
Passage to the outside identifies the result associated with hearing the cry.
The earth's splitting and opening materially completes the sounding-breach mechanism.

structural_cues: 50:41 opens 'listen on the day'; 50:42 immediately repeats 'day,' supplies what is heard, and names exit; 50:44 depicts the earth opening.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cry, exit, and subsequent earth-splitting; I add the arrow that the sound effects or unlocks the opening. The live alternative is accompaniment: the cry announces a rupture caused independently.

changed_reading.before: The caller announces that emergence is occurring.
changed_reading.after: The caller's heard cry acts like a sonic opening through which the enclosed emerge.

context_deltas.mechanism: A destination is brought near and denied remoteness at 50:31; at 50:44 the opened earth yields a rapid gathering driven toward a مقصد. These cues activate the focus call's assembly branches and turn the nearby place into a convergent muster locus.

activation_trace.role: Council and gathering make the caller's act a convocation anchored in the focus.
Nearness supplies the local convergence point for the summons.
Movement into nearness supplies active spatial contraction toward a destination.
Distance as the contrary of nearness makes 'not far' an explicit collapse of remoteness.
Speed removes delay between summons, emergence, and convergence.
Driving and collecting a group toward a مقصد supplies the muster mechanism.

structural_cues: The focus's nearby source stands between 50:31's destination brought near and 50:44's rapid gathering; يوم recurs across the closing sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies spatial contraction, rapid emergence, and directed collection; I identify the caller as the muster signal and the nearby place as its convergence locus. Alternatively, the call's location may describe audibility only, with gathering a separate event.

changed_reading.before: A nearby caller addresses dispersed hearers.
changed_reading.after: A muster call collapses distance and collects the dispersed toward one nearby assembly locus.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates non-call N-D-W and water-seeking Q-R-B branches. It remains anchored by يُنَادِ/ٱلْمُنَادِ and قَرِيب and is reinforced by 50:9-11's water-growth-life-exit chain; render it only as a material analogy, never as a claim that the calling words literally mean dew or irrigation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's N-D-W call words also carry a dew/moisture branch, while Q-R-B carries a branch of approaching nearby water.

activation_trace.role: Dew, rain, and wetness supply a moisture-like material analogue for the call.
Approaching water and a nearby watering place convert focus-nearness into hydrological access.
Delivering water by irrigation or pouring supplies the activating medium.
Plant matter exiting the earth gives the wetting event a visible response.
Rain-given life to earth links moisture directly to revived dormant matter.
Passage outward converts ecological revival into the packet's explicit emergence analogy.

changed_reading.before: The call transmits information to hearers.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the near call behaves like moisture reaching a dormant field: contact activates life and draws what is buried outward.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain model is surprising because it combines distant pregnancy/birth branches from words whose surface uses differ. It remains anchored in قَرِيب's explicit near-birth branch and the focus place, while 50:42-44 supply exit and rupture; downstream prose should label it a contained spatial-material analogy, not identify the nearby place literally as a womb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قَرِيب modifies مَّكَانٍ, and the Q-R-B inventory explicitly includes nearness to birth.

activation_trace.role: Nearness to birth supplies a threshold sense for the focus adjective.
Place as a locus of being keeps the birth-threshold image spatially anchored.
The pregnancy branch supplies containment and gestation despite the surface phrase's bodily-cord use.
The branch of one coming outside at birth links witness-presence to arrival.
Exit supplies release from the containing place.
The earth's opening provides the releasing rupture of the threshold model.

changed_reading.before: The nearby place is only the caller's coordinate.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is a birth-near threshold: the summons accompanies rupture and the release of hidden lives into the open.

strongest_changes: 50:37 turns listening into deliberate, heart-linked witness-presence rather than passive audibility.
50:42-44 make the call an emergence signal, with a live medium-confidence reading of sonic breach.
50:31 and 50:44 turn the nearby source into a convergent muster locus as distance contracts and a group is driven to a مقصد.
summary.what_was_special: The same focus roots recur in tightly placed context constructions, while branch images connect hidden sound, witness-hearing, sounding fracture, and directed gathering. The packet also sustained two contained material analogies—germination and birth—without requiring either to displace the ordinary call sense.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether 50:42's cry is identical with 50:41's call or a distinct co-occurring sound.
Whether 50:16's intimate nearness should govern 50:41's geometry or remain a separate relation.
The ecological and birth models are analogical branch activations, not lexical disambiguations.
